votes.motion: A motion was made by Ryan Mecham, seconded by Zach Robinson to approve the Consent Calendar

A motion was made by Marci Houseman, seconded by Zach Robinson to approve Resolution #23-13c, a resolution approving the 2023 Annual Action Plan for the use of CDBG funds during the 2023 program year and authorizing the Mayor to submit the 2023 Annual Action Plan to HUD and execute associated documents
A motion was made by Zach Robinson, seconded by Ryan Mecham to Call to Question, to end the discussion on the motion on the floor

A motion was made by Ryan Mecham, seconded by Zach Robinson to amend Resolution 23-14, adding the term of service for the Council Member appointment to begin April 18, 2023 and ending when the 2024 Council Committee assignments become effective

A motion was made by Zach Robinson, seconded by Ryan Mecham to appoint Council Member Brooke D'Sousa and Council Director, Dustin Fratto, to serve on the Survey Approval Team for the term specified in the amendment to the Resolution
A motion was made by Ryan Mecham, seconded by Cyndi Sharkey to convene a closed session in the Council Chambers to discuss the deployment of security personnel, devices, or systems
